|damage = 40-55 |csc = .02 |gprice = Not Sold |value = 350 |stats = {{Name|Speed w|−2}} }} '''The Slammer''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be obtained as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item drop]] on Floors 81-99 of [[The Mines]], in the [[Skull Cavern]], or in the [[Quarry Mine]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]].
